initial_run.scope: Real native BF16 model generation and planner abstention verified; retrieval, writer and verifier were not exercised by this run
initial_run.private_artifact_readback: All three saved case checksum files independently read back in the connected Colab session; runner copy/readback passed
initial_run.inference_kernels: Native reference PyTorch kernels; causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention were not installed

limitations: Functional development sample, not independent test performance
Same-model verifier is not independent factual truth
No diagnostic accuracy, clinical benefit or improved predictive AP is established

followup_run.timing_scope: Sum of measured generation calls; excludes download, weight load, data/cache work and artifact copies
followup_run.private_artifact_readback: Runner copied/read-verified all artifacts in private Drive. A separate inspection cell read all three case JSON files and verified their saved SHA256 checksum files.
followup_run.inference_kernels: Native reference PyTorch kernels; causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention were not installed
followup_run.observed_output_scope: All three planners chose the same general sepsis query and retrieved the same passages. Outputs were general educational sepsis definitions/context. Patient-specific explanation quality, variable uncertainty routing and retry behavior were not established by this small sample.
followup_run.verification_scope: Exact citation/numeric checks plus same-backbone entailment, not independent clinical/factual certification
followup_run.sampling_scope: Same three deterministic A/validation endpoints as the first development run; no label-based sampling or independent holdout evaluation
followup_run.change_from_initial: Planner prompt explicitly requests reference lookup before evidence sufficiency assessment; writer/verifier prompts, citation guards, predictor, calibration, corpus text and budgets were preserved

resolved_blockers: Google sign-in completed in the connected browser
User explicitly approved the Google Drive for desktop OAuth connection; private Drive mount succeeded
Initial live reference HTTP 403 fixed by bundled government text snapshots with the same earlier source hashes
Initial deliberate pre-search abstention addressed by clarifying the planning task; first run preserved
remaining_limits: Three-case development functional check, not clinical validation or an independent benchmark
General context only; no demonstrated patient-specific explanation benefit or improved predictive AP
Optimized causal_conv1d and flash-linear-attention kernels were not installed; native reference kernels ran correctly
Model-load peak allocation was measured; generation peak memory was not recorded
No B evaluation or blinded explanation-quality comparison performed
